title: Plane Poiseuille flow in a 2D channel, fully developed inflow (laminar, exact)
description:
Steady laminar flow of an incompressible Newtonian fluid in a straight 2D channel (plane Poiseuille flow).
Geometry (STEP, planar face in the xy-plane): rectangle 0 <= x <= L, 0 <= y <= H with L = 0.05 m (flow direction) and H = 0.01 m (gap between the walls). Model it as 2D; report forces and flow rates per metre of depth (out-of-plane thickness 1 m).
Fluid: density rho = 1000.0 kg/m^3, dynamic viscosity mu = 0.01 Pa s.
Boundary conditions:
  inlet x = 0: fully developed parabolic velocity profile with mean velocity U = 0.01 m/s,
    u_x(y) = 6 U (y/H)(1 - y/H) = 600.0*y*(0.01 - y)  [m/s, y in m],  u_y = 0
  outlet x = L: static pressure p = 0 Pa
  walls y = 0 and y = H: no slip (stationary)
Report (SI units):
  dp_AB             static pressure difference p(A) - p(B) between the centreline points A = (0.0125, 0.005) and B = (0.0375, 0.005) [Pa]
  u_centreline      u_x on the centreline at C = (0.025, 0.005) [m/s]
  wall_force_bottom x-component of the force of the fluid (pressure + viscous) on the wall y = 0 [N per m depth]
  wall_force_top    the same on the wall y = H [N per m depth]
  flow_rate_outlet  volumetric flow rate through the outlet, positive out of the channel [m^3/s per m depth]
The force and flow-rate QoIs refer to the boundary groups wall_bottom, wall_top and outlet: use these names for the corresponding mesh groups.
